text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, dammit! I misread her!
Her Majesty, conqueror of the Japan Cup,
has a completely different burst in the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Still, this is a valuable log. It is precisely the positions I misread that provide the pieces to find my next winning line.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh... For my part, training alongside someone who commands such diverse tactics offers much to learn.
Might I trouble you for another run before the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I welcome my strategy notebook growing thicker.
Whenever you wish, I am at your disposal.
Days of steady, rigorous training continued in preparation for the Arima Kinen.

The lineup for this year's Arima Kinen is stacked
with formidable contenders, including her peers
and Buena Vista herself—

Among them, Rose Kingdom had remarkably placed second in the fan vote,
securing her entry with a result that clearly reflected
the passionate expectations resting upon her.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is tied deeply to the prosperity of our clan.
I wish to live up to the people's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I'll run just a little more before heading back.
See you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Is this the last? ...My body feels rather heavy.
I should return soon—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(............
However... there is still time to spare.
If it is only one more set...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Right. ...Taaah!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer.
Then—one morning.

Though she stood just as composed as ever,
something about her... felt strangely off.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: What is the matter?
choice_data_list: ……ご体調にお変わりはないですか？

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Yes.
Without question......—

Holding her as she crouched in pain, clutching her stomach,
I jumped into a taxi and rushed straight to the hospital—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It appears to be an internal ailment. Likely a temporary issue caused by fatigue building up and lowering her immunity.
Please rest assured, it is nothing serious.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Still...
the Arima Kinen is just around the corner, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Am I cleared to run?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—It is not impossible.
However, I cannot in good conscience recommend it.
I believe this time should be devoted to rest.
Whether she should run in the Arima Kinen or not was something I needed to discuss with her thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —The Arima Kinen represents a monumental opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
We must strike while the iron is hot.
This is the race to solidify the public's expectations born from the Japan Cup, as true victors.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I bear the solemn vow to establish the Rose clan as an eternal kingdom that endures for all time.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware of the danger.
Yet I swear, I will make a full recovery
in time for the Arima Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, I shall seize victory.
I have seen everything through to this point.
It is by no means impossible.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The blunder was mine.
I will take responsibility. —Allow me to take it.
Please, let it be upon the turf...!

My voice dropped involuntarily.
Right now, she is far too――consumed by guilt.

The Arima Kinen is a Grand Prix race.
In other words, the roster is filled with nothing but distinguished Umamusume representing their respective generations.

There was no way she didn't understand the sheer peril
of running a battle where one must stake their very life,
all while carrying such immense risk.
choice_data_list: 貴方は、薔薇一族の未来を背負う方

text_block_list.text:
“If you are conscious of that fact,
then please assess your own condition with a cool head.”

Dead silence filled the Trainer's office.
To her, standing with her lips pressed firmly together,
I added just one final word.
choice_data_list: 成すべきは『有馬記念』の先にも、無数に

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: To have forced such words from your lips...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Let us forgo the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I wish to set our sights on the Nikkei Shinshun Hai, which paves the way to the spring mid-to-long-distance GⅠ campaign. Until then, I shall put everything in order and stage a decisive comeback.

The Nikkei Shinshun Hai is a 2,400-meter GⅡ turf race held at Kyoto.
In terms of timing, it should pose no issue.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I would like to entrust the reports to various parties to you.
Please schedule an MTG for a later date. As for me, I have a few—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I need to cool my head.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...—Fools.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Well, look who it is.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Have you grown homesick for your castle, my prince?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Withdrawing from the Arima Kinen, are you?
Heh—don't look so crestfallen.
You have a clear path to recovery in sight, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes. However—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I threw away everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"'Betraying expectations'? Whoa, hold on now.
Don't make light of a Grand Prix race."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Every one of them is a player worthy of the spotlight.
Even if one is removed, the board's fever pitch will not waver.
All it means is that an even fiercer game than expected will unfold.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Forgive me.
You are right, I was arrogant.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...
Still, well—speaking for myself personally.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Your absence is regrettable beyond measure.

Another sigh slipped out.
Considering the burden she carries, it was only natural
for her to feel restless at such a critical juncture.

I failed completely to notice the possibility that
she might inadvertently increase her voluntary training.
choice_data_list: （……俺がもっと用心していれば）
（……私がもっと用心していれば）

text_block_list.text: Watching the Arima Kinen would likely be too cruel for her right now.
I sent an email requesting that she take a restful vacation for a while, partly to condition her mind and body for the Nikkei Shinshun Hai.
—There.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I apologize.
I wanted to convey this to you in person, with my own words.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"As for the Arima Kinen...
I want to see it in person, with my own eyes."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is plain as day that it will only leave me despondent.
And yet—all the more reason to engrave it into my flesh.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
So that I never repeat that mistake.
So that I never forget my sworn ambition.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: And to make yet more roses bloom—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me go see it.
...I beg of you.
